scope: Bounded documentary follow-up for lot18; no fabrication, measurements, catalogue/registry or old report changes.

baseline.target: Official current Bajaj Boxer125HD RDC red-long-visor appearance; model year unknown. Game marking WEWA original.
baseline.calibration: Official turntable rasters are not a measured/orthographic camera. Wheelbase1285mm does not certify local dimensions or hidden mounting geometry.

result.summary: One isolated rack top/oblique and one detailed outer side-cover photo improve related-part visual documentation. No superior current125HD RDC tank underside/top, cover back or smooth-seat underside was established. Stop here; no G1/G2/G3/G8 passage claimed.

images.direction: Dessus oblique du porte-bagages isolé ; orientation précise avant/arrière déduite de la disposition, non mesurée.

observed: Isolated black frame with rounded outer plateau loop, a flat slotted plate, two long side arms and projecting mounting tabs.
Four elongated openings are visible in that supplier plate, offering a view of negative space hidden or tiny on the official assembled-bike turns.
Long arms include changes of direction and flattened end regions; their true section, hole axes and hidden underside are not recovered from this angle.
new_useful_sources.comparison_to_RDC: Official R00/R04/R05/R06/R07 show the same broad family of rack behind the saddle with side branches. Available resolution/angles do not certify this supplier’s exact plate, tubes or brackets on the RDC bike. The shared catalogue candidate number PF231405 is not a dimensional identity proof.
new_useful_sources.new_faces: Top surface/negative spaces of one isolated related rack; portions of outer arms and tabs. No calibrated underside or opposite side.
do_not_transfer: Do not copy slot count, tube diameter, arm bend radii, material alloy or mounting coordinates to the RDC asset as established facts.
The WAY-C watermark and source pixels stay private; no paint/decal texture extraction.

observed: Foreground cover has a broad rounded triangular white glossy outer face, curved upper edge and rounded lower apex; the large BM150 graphic is printed decoration, not geometry.
Black lower/forward region reads as finer textured surface, with a round rim containing a large noncircular opening.
The foreground face reveals continuous bulging/edge returns more clearly than the tiny official mounted cover. No rear pins or inside ribs are shown.
An additional white edge is visible behind the foreground part, without sufficient visibility to identify side, back or a complete matched pair.
new_useful_sources.comparison_to_RDC: RDC panels are red/black and marked125HD; the current profile fastener is small. The Matriz cover is white/BM150 with a conspicuous larger lock/opening region. It cannot be adopted as the exact current LH/RH panel or mirrored to fabricate the other side.
new_useful_sources.new_faces: Detailed exterior only; no improvement to the missing back/clip/grommet geometry.
do_not_transfer: No certified LH/RH designation from the product photo alone.
Do not replace the RDC small fastener by the larger Matriz aperture or copy its decoration.
No metric curvature, lip thickness, pin depth or mounting distance established.

reason: Three genuinely inspected product views expose top/side/underside, but the tall-front/long tapering profile, exposed terminal flange and Kawasaki-era marking identify a visibly different/unconfirmed product family from the broad-shouldered current RDC red tank.
Its good underside photo is not a justification to transfer tunnel, mounts, seam or tap flange to the target. These are negative compatibility evidence only.
No manufacturer CAD, measured section or isolated underside of the exact current RDC tank was obtained.
